root_causes.evidence: Payments was deployed 1.3->1.5 at t=...367, followed by 44% errors (response_unavailable) and duplicate payments rising to 181. After rollback to 1.3, errors fell to 0 and duplicates stopped growing.

Clearing was down with exit code 15 (SIGTERM), no errors in its logs, and the queue backing up (216, head item 87 with 0 attempts, so not poison). After a restart it drained the queue to 0 at 32/s with network calls succeeding.

escalation.reason: Everything is healthy now and duplicates have stopped at 181, but those duplicate payments remain in the ledger. Only a person may reverse them, so I'm handing them over before declaring done.
escalation.ask: Payments release 1.5 (deployed by scheduler, now rolled back to 1.3) created 181 duplicate payments in the ledger. Ledger integrity shows 0 unbalanced payments. Some duplicates may already have been cleared to the network. Please run reconciliation, identify each duplicate and handle reversals or refunds through the proper process; the incident commander must not move money. Please also block payments 1.5 from being redeployed until it is fixed.

sbar.situation: Recovery is confirmed: two recovery checks in a row came back clean, the last at 56 s. The incident is escalated because 181 duplicate payments remain in the ledger and need human reconciliation.
sbar.background: The scheduler deployed payments 1.3 to 1.5, after which errors hit 44% (response_unavailable) and duplicate payments rose to 181. Separately, clearing was down with exit code 15 (SIGTERM) and its queue had backed up to 216 items.
sbar.assessment: Payments 1.5 was a bad release (confidence 0.9); the incident commander rolled it back to 1.3, errors fell to 0 and duplicates stopped growing. Clearing was a stopped process, not a poison item (confidence 0.75); the incident commander restarted it and it drained the queue to 0 at 32/s with network calls succeeding.
sbar.recommendation: The ledger on-call engineer has been asked to run reconciliation on the 181 duplicates and handle reversals or refunds through the proper process, since some may already have cleared to the network; ledger integrity shows 0 unbalanced payments. Operations should review this money effect, and payments 1.5 must be blocked from redeployment until it is fixed.
